record.question: The term demographic dividend refers to:
record.explanation: Answer B: Rise in working-age population. A demographic dividend refers to a rising share of working-age people relative to dependants. Reference: https://www.unfpa.org/demographic-dividend. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
